name: 3doptix
description: Optical design and simulation powered by the 3DOptix platform. Bundles the 3DOptix MCP server with skills for setup creation, component placement, ray-trace simulation, analysis and optimisation.

interface.shortDescription: Design, simulate and analyse optical systems
interface.longDescription: Build optical setups, place lenses, mirrors and detectors, run GPU ray-trace simulations, analyse spot diagrams and irradiance, optimise layouts, and import existing designs from Zemax or CAD — all through the 3DOptix cloud platform.
